Alternative labels: narrative approaches

## Definition and typical features 
Methods research often relies on informal approaches. For example, instead of conducting formal reviews, authors may selectively cite methodological publications. Informal approaches often rely on professional authority and persuasive narrative. They may integrate expert opinions without structured collaboration or formal consensus studies. They may use theory, examples, or simulations to illustrate points rather than to answer a methodological research questions.
